expected.description: When behaviour-diff.sh is stopped by TERM or INT, the probe it started in its own session keeps running, because killpg runs only on the timeout path.
A probe that cannot start at either commit is reported as 'same' and the run exits 0, although nothing was compared.
Several controls behaviour-diff.sh claims (killpg on every exit, the hooksPath override, the stderr comparison, stdin from /dev/null) have no test: a mutant removing each still passes the suite.
